requirement: Native MCP clients use exact callbacks and site-bound OAuth grants

oracle.invariant: Only each client’s registered callbacks reach sign-in; altered hosts, ports, paths, queries and other clients’ callbacks are rejected. Both decisions arrive at the exact callback with state and issuer. Allow stores one site-bound code; Cancel stores none. Authorization codes require S256, the exact stored callback, client and resource. Cross-client refresh/revoke cannot affect a connection. Rotation keeps the key id; revocation ends access and refresh; cross-site calls return 403.
